dashboard.title: Signal Explorer
dashboard.description: Explore any raw signal from InfluxDB. Select log file → device type → device ID → signal.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: time(v: "${file_start}"), stop: time(v: "${file_end}"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_telemetry" and r._field == "value" and r.file == "${file}" and r.device_type == "${device_type}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^(${signal:regex})$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id) =~ /^(${device_id:regex})$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 500ms, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: (if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-23" then "FL Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-22" then "FL Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-22" then "FL Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-0" then "FR Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-1" then "FR Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-1" then "FR Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-2" then "BL Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-3" then "BL Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-3" then "BL Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-21" then "BR Drive" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-20" then "BR Steer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-20" then "BR Encoder" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-15" then "Intake Arm" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-15" then "Intake Arm Enc" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-14" then "Intake Wheels" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-13" then "Indexer" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-6" then "Left Chamber" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-17" then "Right Chamber" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-7" then "Left Turret" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-31" then "Left Turret Enc 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-32" then "Left Turret Enc 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-16" then "Right Turret" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-41" then "Right Turret Enc 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "CANcoder-42" then "Right Turret Enc 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-8" then "Left Hood" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-9" then "Right Hood" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-4" then "Left Flywheel 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-5" then "Left Flywheel 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-19" then "Right Flywheel 1" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "TalonFX-18" then "Right Flywheel 2" else if r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id == "Pigeon2-0" then "Pigeon2 IMU" else r.device_type + "-" + r.device_id) + " - " + r.signal}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

list.name: file_start
list.label: File Start
list.query:
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "_upload_tracking" and r.file == "${file}" and r._field == "min_time_us")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: string(v: time(v: int(v: r._value) * 1000))}))

list.name: file_end
list.label: File End
list.query:
import "experimental"
from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "_upload_tracking" and r.file == "${file}" and r._field == "max_time_us")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: string(v: experimental.addDuration(d: 1s, to: time(v: int(v: r._value) * 1000)))}))

list.name: file_end_ms

from(bucket: "robot-telemetry")
